comment: symbols.c parse_sym_line() sends each S_* line of a UTF8-handling symbol set through glyphs.c glyphrep_to_custom_map_entries() instead of showsyms[]. With symset:Enhanced2 its S_amulet: U+2299 line therefore marks only the glyphs of object index AMULET_CLASS - 1, the generic ring (parse_id() gives find_oc the loadsyms[] offset class - 1, and glyph_find_core() compares it with glyph_to_obj()), and its wall lines mark the wall glyphs. Those glyphmap customizations stay when the Rogue level switches to the rogue symbol set. A human Tourist in debug mode level-teleports with ^V to the Rogue level (the menu's 'g' entry) and runs #wizcustom, whose list starts with the generic ring and the main walls. Seed, date, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
